timing: Inspection 4-7 business days after receipt; payment within 24-48 hours after approval (check, PayPal, Zelle).
who_pays: ItsWorthMore, the buyback company itself - they buy your device directly, not through a marketplace of third-party buyers.
who_qualifies: You must be 18+, in the US, and own the device. Only eligible electronics are accepted.
work_available: Yes - the program was live on itsworthmore.com as of 2026-09-23, accepting eligible devices. Value varies by model, condition, and demand.
what_gets_accepted: Your quote is locked for 21 days but only holds if the device matches your description at inspection (4-7 business days after receipt). A mismatch gets a revised, usually lower, offer.
costs_and_unpaid_time: Free shipping and no fees. Skip expedited processing - it cuts your payout. Your unpaid time is getting the quote, shipping, and waiting out the 4-7 business day inspection window.
when_cash_arrives: Real cash paid by check, PayPal, or Zelle, sent within 24-48 hours after your device passes inspection and is approved. PayPal or Zelle arrive fastest; mailed checks are slow.
